units.english: Hai Origins
units.italian: Hai Origins

units.id: start:hai space|description|216|0
units.english: You grew up on Greenwater, a Hai world with a rich and mixed culture thanks to its climate. You've dreamed of owning your own fleet since you were given toy spaceships as a small child. To reach that goal, you worked hard at a travel company, recommending locations in human space.
units.italian: Sei cresciuto su Greenwater, un mondo Hai dalla cultura ricca e mista grazie al suo clima. Sogni di possedere una flotta tutta tua da quando, bambino, ti hanno regalato astronavi giocattolo. Per raggiungere quell'obiettivo hai lavorato sodo in un'agenzia di viaggi, consigliando destinazioni nello spazio umano.

units.id: start:hai space|description|217|0
units.english: Now, as your ferry docks at the main spaceport, you feel like this is the start of a new life as a captain.
units.italian: Ora, mentre il traghetto attracca allo spazioporto principale, senti che questo è l'inizio di una nuova vita come capitano.

units.id: start:hai space|description|223|0
units.english: This start is locked.
units.italian: Questo inizio è bloccato.

units.id: start:hai space|name|227|0
units.english: Hai Origins
units.italian: Hai Origins

units.id: start:hai space|description|228|0
units.english: You grew up on Greenwater, a Hai world with a rich and mixed culture thanks to its climate. You've dreamed of owning your own fleet since you were given toy spaceships as a small child, and you've worked hard at a travel company to reach this goal.
units.italian: Sei cresciuto su Greenwater, un mondo Hai dalla cultura ricca e mista grazie al suo clima. Sogni di possedere una flotta tutta tua da quando, bambino, ti hanno regalato astronavi giocattolo, e hai lavorato sodo in un'agenzia di viaggi per raggiungere quell'obiettivo.

units.id: start:hai space|description|229|0
units.english: Now, as your ferry docks at the main spaceport, you feel like this is the start of a new life as a captain.
units.italian: Ora, mentre il traghetto attracca allo spazioporto principale, senti che questo è l'inizio di una nuova vita come capitano.

units.id: start:hai space|description|230|0
units.english: To unlock this start, you must complete the main human campaign.
units.italian: Per sbloccare questo inizio devi completare la campagna umana principale.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|278|0
units.english: Finally scraped together enough money for a down payment on a starship. The interest on the mortgage is exorbitant.
units.italian: Finalmente ho messo insieme abbastanza soldi per un anticipo su un'astronave. Gli interessi sul mutuo sono esorbitanti.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|279|0
units.english: Hundreds of years ago, the independent territories in different parts of human space agreed to join together into a single democratic government, with Earth as its capital. The rise of the Republic ushered in a long period of peace and prosperity in human history.
units.italian: Centinaia di anni fa i territori indipendenti sparsi nello spazio umano accettarono di unirsi in un unico governo democratico, con la Terra come capitale. L'ascesa della Repubblica inaugurò un lungo periodo di pace e di prosperità nella storia umana.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|Representation in the Republic Parliament is based on population. That means that some individual "Paradise Worlds" have more representatives than entire regions of space like the Dirt Belt that are more sparsely settled.|280|0
units.english: Representation in the Republic Parliament is based on population. That means that some individual "Paradise Worlds" have more representatives than entire regions of space like the Dirt Belt that are more sparsely settled.
units.italian: La rappresentanza in Parlamento repubblicano si basa sulla popolazione. Questo significa che alcuni singoli "Mondi del Paradiso" hanno più rappresentanti di intere regioni come il Dirt Belt, dove la popolazione è più rada.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|281|0
units.english: The Syndicate is a megacorporation, the largest employer in human space. People who cannot find steady work elsewhere flock to the Syndicate factory worlds, where they are almost guaranteed to find a job. Although the Syndicate is technically part of the Republic, Syndicate worlds are governed directly by the corporation.
units.italian: Il Sindacato è una megacorporazione, il più grande datore di lavoro dello spazio umano. Chi non trova un lavoro stabile altrove accorre ai mondi-fabbrica del Sindacato, dove un impiego è quasi garantito. Sebbene il Sindacato faccia tecnicamente parte della Repubblica, i suoi mondi sono governati direttamente dalla corporazione.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|The Syndicate is a central part of the Republic's economy, but they are also well known for selling shoddy products and for doing damage to the environment on the worlds they control. Their treatment of workers is questionable, and their opposition to organized labor is legendary. Some Syndicate factory towns have even been accused of human rights abuses.|282|0
units.english: The Syndicate is a central part of the Republic's economy, but they are also well known for selling shoddy products and for doing damage to the environment on the worlds they control. Their treatment of workers is questionable, and their opposition to organized labor is legendary. Some Syndicate factory towns have even been accused of human rights abuses.
units.italian: Il Sindacato è una parte centrale dell'economia repubblicana, ma è anche noto per vendere prodotti scadenti e per danneggiare l'ambiente dei mondi che controlla. Il trattamento riservato ai lavoratori è discutibile, e la sua opposizione al sindacalismo è leggendaria. Alcune cittadine-fabbrica del Sindacato sono state persino accusate di violazioni dei diritti umani.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|283|0
units.english: In poorer and more remote star systems, where the Navy seldom patrols, pirate attacks on merchant ships are frequent. Pirates are also known to attack large, unguarded convoys of freighters even in more populated areas. Most pirate fleets come from lawless worlds on the outskirts of human space.
units.italian: Nei sistemi stellari più poveri e remoti, dove la Marina pattuglia di rado, gli attacchi pirata alle navi mercantili sono frequenti. I pirati sono noti anche per attaccare grandi convogli di mercantili senza scorta in zone più popolate. La maggior parte delle flotte pirata viene da mondi senza legge ai margini dello spazio umano.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|284|0
units.english: The Hai are a species of giant, intelligent rodents, who live to the north of human space. They allow any humans who discover their territory to live alongside them, and to trade with them and purchase their technology.
units.italian: Gli Hai sono una specie di roditori giganti e intelligenti, che vivono a nord dello spazio umano. Permettono a qualunque umano scopra il loro territorio di vivere accanto a loro, di commerciare con loro e di acquistare la loro tecnologia.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|285|0
units.english: The "Unfettered" are a faction within the Hai species who are not as peaceful as the rest, and are normally not friendly toward humans. They claim that long ago the Drak altered the Hai to make them docile and peaceful, and that the Unfettered are descendants of those Hai who avoided undergoing that alteration. They are seeking jump drives so that they can escape the "prison" they are now stuck in: a few deteriorating worlds on the far northern edge of Hai space.
units.italian: Gli "Unfettered" sono una fazione interna alla specie Hai, meno pacifica del resto e di norma non amichevole verso gli umani. Sostengono che molto tempo fa i Drak alterarono gli Hai per renderli docili e pacifici, e che gli Unfettered discendono da quegli Hai che evitarono quell'alterazione. Cercano motori di salto per fuggire dalla "prigione" in cui sono ora bloccati: alcuni mondi in degrado sul confine più settentrionale dello spazio Hai.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|286|0
units.english: A long extinct dragon-like species called the "Sheragi" used to live in human space, back when much of what is now human territory was occupied by the Hai.
units.italian: Una specie estinta da tempo, simile a un drago, chiamata "Sheragi" viveva nello spazio umano, quando gran parte di quello che oggi è territorio umano era occupato dagli Hai.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|Going to the North Pole already makes you feel as if you're on another world; even within the berth for your ferry, you can see more Hai than there are in your entire hometown. After some parting words from the PA system, you and your fellow passengers disembark, the flow of humanity breaking against the Hai crowd.|288|0
units.english: Going to the North Pole already makes you feel as if you're on another world; even within the berth for your ferry, you can see more Hai than there are in your entire hometown. After some parting words from the PA system, you and your fellow passengers disembark, the flow of humanity breaking against the Hai crowd.
units.italian: Andare al Polo Nord ti fa già sentire come su un altro mondo; anche solo all'interno della banchina del tuo traghetto vedi più Hai di quanti ce ne siano nella tua città natale. Dopo qualche annuncio dall'impianto audio, tu e gli altri passeggeri sbarcate, e il flusso di umanità si infrange contro la folla di Hai.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	Making your way towards the shipyard, you pull up the human-language version of your loan agreement to review: You have borrowed 1.431 million credits to be repaid over the course of two years. Your interest rate is 0.3%, making your repayments 4,836 credits per day.|289|0
units.english: Making your way towards the shipyard, you pull up the human-language version of your loan agreement to review: You have borrowed 1.431 million credits to be repaid over the course of two years. Your interest rate is 0.3%, making your repayments 4,836 credits per day.
units.italian: Mentre ti dirigi verso il cantiere navale, apri la versione in lingua umana del tuo contratto di prestito per rileggerlo: hai preso in prestito 1,431 milioni di crediti, da restituire nell'arco di due anni. Il tuo tasso d'interesse è dello 0,3%, il che rende le tue rate 4.836 crediti al giorno.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	You look up from your tablet just before running head-on into a gray-furred Hai wearing a flight suit, knocking him over. As you bend over to help, he takes a glance at your mortgage documents. "You're about to become a captain, aren't you?" he says after dusting himself off.|290|0
units.english: You look up from your tablet just before running head-on into a gray-furred Hai wearing a flight suit, knocking him over. As you bend over to help, he takes a glance at your mortgage documents. "You're about to become a captain, aren't you?" he says after dusting himself off.
units.italian: Alzi lo sguardo dal tablet appena prima di andare a sbattere contro un Hai dal pelo grigio in tuta da volo, facendolo cadere. Mentre ti chini per aiutarlo, lui dà un'occhiata ai documenti del tuo mutuo. "Stai per diventare capitano, vero?" dice dopo essersi spolverato.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"Yes, I am."|293|0
units.english: "Yes, I am."
units.italian: "Sì, è così."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"How could you tell?"|294|0
units.english: "How could you tell?"
units.italian: "Come hai fatto a capirlo?"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"Who said you could look at that?"|296|0
units.english: "Who said you could look at that?"
units.italian: "Chi ha detto che potevi guardare?"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"Then maybe I can help. Follow me."|299|0
units.english: "Then maybe I can help. Follow me."
units.italian: "Allora forse posso aiutarti. Seguimi."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"From your loan," he replies. "There's only one reason to have that exact number of credits. Speaking of which, I think I can help you."|303|0
units.english: "From your loan," he replies. "There's only one reason to have that exact number of credits. Speaking of which, I think I can help you."
units.italian: "Dal tuo prestito," risponde. "C'è una sola ragione per avere esattamente quel numero di crediti. A proposito, credo di poterti aiutare."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	He scratches the back of his head. "Sorry. I was just trying to help, but if I'm causing too much trouble, I'll get out of your way.|307|0
units.english: He scratches the back of his head. "Sorry. I was just trying to help, but if I'm causing too much trouble, I'll get out of your way.
units.italian: Si gratta la nuca. "Scusa. Volevo solo aiutare, ma se ti sto creando troppo disturbo, mi tolgo di mezzo.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"I don't mind."|309|0
units.english: "I don't mind."
units.italian: "Non mi dispiace."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"I'd rather handle things myself."|311|0
units.english: "I'd rather handle things myself."
units.italian: "Preferisco cavarmela da solo."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	He bows. "Thank you."|314|0
units.english: He bows. "Thank you."
units.italian: Si inchina. "Grazie."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	The Hai brings you to the landing pads of Greenwater, where a large number of humans and Hai are gathered around several vessels. From the crowd, another Hai approaches your companion, talking to him in Hai. The gray-furred Hai simply nods and hands the other Hai a set of keys in exchange for a credit chip. The other Hai quickly bows before dashing towards one of the landed ships.|317|0
units.english: The Hai brings you to the landing pads of Greenwater, where a large number of humans and Hai are gathered around several vessels. From the crowd, another Hai approaches your companion, talking to him in Hai. The gray-furred Hai simply nods and hands the other Hai a set of keys in exchange for a credit chip. The other Hai quickly bows before dashing towards one of the landed ships.
units.italian: L'Hai ti porta alle piazzole di Greenwater, dove una gran folla di umani e Hai si è radunata attorno a diverse navi. Dalla folla un altro Hai si avvicina al tuo compagno e gli parla in Hai. L'Hai dal pelo grigio si limita a fare un cenno e consegna all'altro un mazzo di chiavi in cambio di un gettone di credito. L'altro Hai si inchina in fretta e corre verso una delle navi atterrate.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"I'm selling off my fleet before retiring," the Hai says. "Sure, I could just go to the shipyard, but I could never have started if it weren't for another retiring captain selling me a ship for cheap when I was young. So, I've decided to pay it forward and help out other captains-to-be."|318|0
units.english: "I'm selling off my fleet before retiring," the Hai says. "Sure, I could just go to the shipyard, but I could never have started if it weren't for another retiring captain selling me a ship for cheap when I was young. So, I've decided to pay it forward and help out other captains-to-be."
units.italian: "Sto vendendo la mia flotta prima di andare in pensione," dice l'Hai. "Certo, potrei semplicemente andare al cantiere navale, ma non avrei mai potuto cominciare se un altro capitano in pensione non mi avesse venduto una nave a poco prezzo quando ero giovane. Così ho deciso di restituire il favore e aiutare altri futuri capitani."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	The Hai walks up to one of the smaller ships in the fleet, a Grasshopper interceptor. "This is the Pristine Jewel. She's served me well over the past century, but I'm sure she'll be safe in your hands."|319|0
units.english: The Hai walks up to one of the smaller ships in the fleet, a Grasshopper interceptor. "This is the Pristine Jewel. She's served me well over the past century, but I'm sure she'll be safe in your hands."
units.italian: L'Hai si avvicina a una delle navi più piccole della flotta, un intercettore Grasshopper. "Questa è la Pristine Jewel. Mi ha servito bene nell'ultimo secolo, ma sono certo che sarà al sicuro nelle tue mani."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"You're giving it to me?"|321|0
units.english: "You're giving it to me?"
units.italian: "Me la stai regalando?"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"Is there a freighter I could take instead?"|322|0
units.english: "Is there a freighter I could take instead?"
units.italian: "C'è un mercantile che potrei prendere al suo posto?"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"What about the other people here? Shouldn't they get first pick?"|324|0
units.english: "What about the other people here? Shouldn't they get first pick?"
units.italian: "E le altre persone qui? Non dovrebbero avere la precedenza?"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	The Hai chuckles. "That would be nice, wouldn't it? Unfortunately, retirement isn't cheap. I'd be happy to part with her for 1.132 million credits, though; that's less than a Aphid, let alone a new Grasshopper.|327|0
units.english: The Hai chuckles. "That would be nice, wouldn't it? Unfortunately, retirement isn't cheap. I'd be happy to part with her for 1.132 million credits, though; that's less than a Aphid, let alone a new Grasshopper.
units.italian: L'Hai ridacchia. "Sarebbe bello, vero? Purtroppo la pensione non è economica. Sarei però felice di separarmene per 1,132 milioni di crediti; meno di un Aphid, figuriamoci di un Grasshopper nuovo.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"Unfortunately, all my Aphids were bought earlier today. Still, I'm sure you can survive; the Unfettered'll be a tough ask, but pirates in human space won't be much of a match. Plus, if you still can't handle it, you can always sell her. She'll only cost you 1.132 million credits, and you'll be able to use the old parts of the Pristine Jewel to buy an Aphid at a discount.|331|0
units.english: "Unfortunately, all my Aphids were bought earlier today. Still, I'm sure you can survive; the Unfettered'll be a tough ask, but pirates in human space won't be much of a match. Plus, if you still can't handle it, you can always sell her. She'll only cost you 1.132 million credits, and you'll be able to use the old parts of the Pristine Jewel to buy an Aphid at a discount.
units.italian: "Purtroppo tutti i miei Aphid sono stati comprati stamattina. Comunque sono certo che sopravviverai; gli Unfettered saranno un osso duro, ma i pirati nello spazio umano non saranno un gran problema. E se proprio non ce la fai, puoi sempre venderla. Ti costerà solo 1,132 milioni di crediti, e potrai usare i pezzi vecchi della Pristine Jewel per comprare un Aphid con uno sconto.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	The Hai shakes his head. "Don't worry. Most of the crowd are just spectators. Usually it'd be a human captain pulling a stunt like selling their fleet publicly; most retiring Hai just donate their fleets to the government. I'm not exactly handing these ships out for free either. If you want her, the Pristine Jewel's 1.132 million credits.|335|0
units.english: The Hai shakes his head. "Don't worry. Most of the crowd are just spectators. Usually it'd be a human captain pulling a stunt like selling their fleet publicly; most retiring Hai just donate their fleets to the government. I'm not exactly handing these ships out for free either. If you want her, the Pristine Jewel's 1.132 million credits.
units.italian: L'Hai scuote la testa. "Non preoccuparti. La maggior parte della folla sono solo spettatori. Di solito è un capitano umano a fare un colpo di testa come vendere pubblicamente la propria flotta; la maggior parte degli Hai in pensione dona la flotta al governo. E non sto esattamente regalando queste navi. Se la vuoi, la Pristine Jewel costa 1,132 milioni di crediti.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"So, do we have a deal?"|338|0
units.english: "So, do we have a deal?"
units.italian: "Allora, affare fatto?"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"We do!"|340|0
units.english: "We do!"
units.italian: "Affare fatto!"

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"I think I'd be better off buying from the shipyard."|341|0
units.english: "I think I'd be better off buying from the shipyard."
units.italian: "Credo che mi converrebbe comprare dal cantiere navale."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	"Great!" He holds out a data tablet. "Just sign here, and she's yours."|344|0
units.english: "Great!" He holds out a data tablet. "Just sign here, and she's yours."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" Tende un tablet. "Firma qui e sarà tua."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	The Hai gives you the keys to the Grasshopper after you hand over the tablet and your payment. "Looks like this your first step to becoming an interstellar entrepreneur. I'd say we'll meet again someday, but I'd rather not lie. In all my years, I never did meet the captain who sold me my first ship again. Not that that should matter, anyway; this is your story, not mine."|350|0
units.english: The Hai gives you the keys to the Grasshopper after you hand over the tablet and your payment. "Looks like this your first step to becoming an interstellar entrepreneur. I'd say we'll meet again someday, but I'd rather not lie. In all my years, I never did meet the captain who sold me my first ship again. Not that that should matter, anyway; this is your story, not mine."
units.italian: L'Hai ti dà le chiavi del Grasshopper dopo che gli hai consegnato il tablet e il pagamento. "Sembra che questo sia il tuo primo passo per diventare un imprenditore interstellare. Direi che ci rivedremo un giorno, ma preferisco non mentire. In tutti questi anni non ho mai più incontrato il capitano che mi ha venduto la prima nave. Non che importi: questa è la tua storia, non la mia."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	He gives you one last salute before returning to the crowd to sell yet another ship.|351|0
units.english: He gives you one last salute before returning to the crowd to sell yet another ship.
units.italian: Ti fa un ultimo saluto e torna tra la folla a vendere un'altra nave.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	He nods as you head towards the shipyard.|355|0
units.english: He nods as you head towards the shipyard.
units.italian: Fa un cenno col capo mentre ti avvii verso il cantiere navale.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	At its entrance is an automated security kiosk. You quickly fill out the form on the screen before picking up the stylus and signing your name:|356|0
units.english: At its entrance is an automated security kiosk. You quickly fill out the form on the screen before picking up the stylus and signing your name:
units.italian: All'ingresso c'è un chiosco di sicurezza automatico. Compili in fretta il modulo sullo schermo, poi prendi lo stilo e firmi il tuo nome:

units.id: conversation:hai intro|	You step through glass sliding doors into Greenwater's shipyard. In most of the berths, workers are busy refurbishing old vessels for resale, but in some of the more distant bays, you can see the flash of welding torches on brand-new ship skeletons. Vessels of all sizes are lined up within the yard, but for you, there's only one option...|358|0
units.english: You step through glass sliding doors into Greenwater's shipyard. In most of the berths, workers are busy refurbishing old vessels for resale, but in some of the more distant bays, you can see the flash of welding torches on brand-new ship skeletons. Vessels of all sizes are lined up within the yard, but for you, there's only one option...
units.italian: Attraversi porte scorrevoli di vetro ed entri nel cantiere di Greenwater. Nella maggior parte delle banchine gli operai sono impegnati a rimettere a nuovo vecchie navi per la rivendita, ma in alcune baie più lontane vedi il lampo delle torce di saldatura su scheletri di navi nuove di zecca. Navi di ogni dimensione sono allineate nel cantiere, ma per te c'è una sola opzione...
